changes.to: The maker (ZIONEER Robotics, Jilin) describes Xiaomu only as a commercial-service and pharmacy robot that builds its own semantic map of a store; its site publishes no dimensions, payload, battery or speed. The maker's copy also does not describe it as a humanoid, so the humanoid category may need review.
Commercial-service and pharmacy robot that maps a store and runs night-time sales, guidance and consultation tasks.
